title: Zoje ZJ5780BS
subtitle: Electronic Straight Buttonhole Sewing Machine

purposeAndApplication.purpose: The ZJ5780BS is an electronically controlled straight buttonhole sewing machine with 30+ programmable buttonhole patterns. Designed for men's and women's garments with plain or bartacked buttonholes.
applications: Straight buttonholes on shirts, blouses, jackets, trousers
Programmable buttonhole length and bartack variations
purposeAndApplication.industry: Garment manufacturing (shirts, blouses, jackets, work-wear, formal wear)

overviewDescription: Made by Zoje (Zhejiang, China). Part of the ZJ5780 buttonhole family. Related models include ZJ-5780L (longer buttonhole range 9.4–120 mm), ZJ-5780AS (Asian-market variant), ZJ-5780S (Russian-market variant). The ZJ5780BS is the base straight-buttonhole configuration with 30 built-in patterns, programmable via the on-board control panel.
